about.title: Making learning
about.story:
Culture was born from a simple observation: professional training is too often boring, too long, and too quickly forgotten. Trainers spend hours creating content that learners just skim through.

What if technology could change that? AI can now transform any content into an adaptive, engaging learning path — like Duolingo did for languages, but for any skill domain.

Culture is that tool. Built for trainers who have the expertise but not the time. For learners who genuinely want to progress. For organizations that need to measure the impact of every euro invested in training.

values.title: Our values
values.v1Desc: Gamification and AI are means, not ends. Every feature is designed to improve real learning outcomes.
values.v2Desc: A trainer must be able to create their first workshop in 10 minutes, with zero prior training.
values.v3Desc: You deserve to know whether your training actually works. We give you the data to prove it.

ai.title: Generate with AI
ai.subtitle: The AI completes this workshop: whatever already exists is reused, never redone.

hint.label: DETAILS (OPTIONAL)
hint.placeholder: e.g. split by themes, there are 4 — the document calls them “Units”.
hint.help: What the AI cannot guess: how many parts you expect, the level of splitting (broad themes or sub-chapters), the word used in the document, the students’ level. This takes precedence over our defaults.

provider.label: MODEL FOR QUESTIONS
provider.help: Only affects question writing, which does not read the documents. Chapters and notions stay on Claude, the only one that reads PDFs without losing their diagrams.

ai.keepOpen: Keep this tab open: generation stops if you close it. Whatever was written stays, and stays undoable.
ai.cancellable: You can undo this import for 24 hours, as long as nothing has been edited.

banner.alsoRemoves: Undoing also removes {items} from the same import.
banner.parcoursQuestions: {count, plural, one {# learning-path question} other {# learning-path questions}}
banner.examQuestions: {count, plural, one {# exam question} other {# exam questions}}
banner.previous: {count, plural, one {# earlier import} other {# earlier imports}}

estimate.preparingHint: The documents are sent to the provider; generation starts right after.

plan.program: The AI will read the documents, extract the notions, sort them into chapters, then write the practice questions. Whatever already exists is completed, never redone.
plan.programThenQuestions: This workshop has no notion in its programme yet: the AI will build it from the documents first, then write this list’s questions.
plan.parcoursQuestions: The AI will top up the practice questions for notions that are still short. The documents are not read again.
plan.examQuestions: The AI will write exam questions across the whole programme — each crossing several notions, some following on from one another. The documents are not read again.
plan.questionsOnly: No readable document in this workshop: the AI will not touch the programme. It will write the practice questions still missing from the existing notions.
plan.nothing: Nothing to work from yet: this workshop has neither a readable document nor a notion in its programme. Add a PDF or a text file in Resources.

examCount.label: NUMBER OF QUESTIONS
examCount.help: Individual questions, for the whole programme rather than per chapter — a ballpark, not an exact count. A third of them will come in groups of two or three. Running it again adds as many, without repeating existing ones.

stop.title: Stop generating?
stop.body: Whatever was written will be removed: the workshop goes back to how it was. This closes right away, the cleanup finishes on its own.
